purpose: Examples for CMDBuild attribute validationRules fields.
notes: Put the JavaScript into the attribute validationRules field.
Do not create separate validation-rule schema objects.
CMDBuild executes the value as a JavaScript function body: use top-level return statements.
Return true when the card is valid; return a string to block save and show an error message.
Use api.getValue("AttributeCode") to read other fields from the same card.
Normalize decimal text with String(value).replace(',', '.') before numeric comparison.

validates: all and any require empty threshold and empty n
threshold requires threshold from 0 to 100 and empty n
n_of_m requires integer n >= 1 and empty threshold
filled sla_target must be a percentage from 0 to 100
filled priority must be an integer from 1 to 100
